description: Attach what actually happened to a sealed prediction (append-only) and get the evaluation. creative_comparison actual: {metric:'ctr', values:[{creativeId?|variant?, value, impressions?, clicks?}]}; impressions and clicks let Aetherya record the result for calibration (see calibrationRecorded). video_analysis actual: {threeSecondHoldPct?, biggestDropSec?, watchedFullPct?}. Other kinds: any object.

note.description: Optional free-text note stored with the outcome.

source.description: Where the numbers came from, e.g. 'client_email_2026-10-09'.

name: aetherya_record_outcome
title: Record the real outcome of a sealed prediction
